context: Daichi and Mei enjoy a coastal view.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: travel chat; vocabulary (波/辺/眺め/各地/通っ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: この辺の眺め、ほんまにええなあ。
lines.en: The view around here is really nice.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 波の音が、心地よいですね。
lines.en: The sound of the waves is soothing.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle dreamy delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 各地を回ったけど、ここが一番や。
lines.en: I've toured many places, but here's the best.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: この道、前に通ったことあります?
lines.en: Have you passed this road before?
lines.style: curious woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 昔、よくこの辺を通ったわ。
lines.en: I used to pass around here often.
lines.style: nostalgic Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 波の眺めは、各地で違いますね。
lines.en: Wave views differ from place to place.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: この辺の波は、穏やかで好きや。
lines.en: I love how gentle the waves are here.
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: また、この眺めを見に通いたいです。
lines.en: I'd like to keep coming for this view.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm closing delivery throughout
